result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but there are a few visual issues: a horizontally cut-off card in the carousel, a duplicate restaurant listing, and content cropped at the bottom of the viewport.

issues.description: The 'Smash Bros Bu...' card in the 'Fastest near you' section is cut off at the right edge of the screen with no visible indication it scrolls horizontally.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the carousel has adequate scroll affordance (e.g., partial peek of next card or scroll indicator) so users know more content exists off-screen.

issues.description: 'Green Bowl Poké' appears twice in a row in the 'Fastest near you' section with identical imagery, delivery fee, and delivery time, which looks like a data duplication error.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the restaurant list or verify the data source so the same restaurant isn't shown twice consecutively.

issues.description: The second card in 'Popular right now' (pizza with -20% badge) is cut off at the bottom of the viewport, hiding its restaurant name and details.
issues.suggestion: This is likely just scroll position, but ensure enough card content peeks above the fold so users can tell it's scrollable content.
